sentences.text: Report of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jind has been received, wherein it has been reported that statements of petitioner/accused Ram Mehar son of Sh.Mai Ram and complainant Ram Mehar son of Sh. 1 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:021130 CRM-M-34019-2023(O&M) 2 2024:PHHC:021130 4.
The complainant/Ram Mehar, son of Sh.Baljora Singh, in his statement had stated that he has no objection in case the FIR in question is quashed.
5. The learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jind, has specifically opined that the parties have entered into compromise voluntarily without there being any pressure, coercion or undue influence.

State of Punjab, the present petition is allowed and FIR No.195 dated 18.04.2023, Police Station City Jind, District Jind, under Sections 406, 420 IPC and all subsequent proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed qua the petitioner.
